idea-plugin.name: Terminal Safety Rails
idea-plugin.description:
Terminal Safety Rails

A single destructive command can ruin your day. Terminal Safety Rails intercepts dangerous commands like rm -rf, kubectl delete, and terraform destroy before they execute — showing a risk-level dialog that requires explicit confirmation.

Key Features

  • Command Interception — Catches dangerous commands before execution in the IDE terminal
  • Risk Levels — 🔴 CRITICAL, 🟠 HIGH, 🟡 MEDIUM severity with color-coded dialogs
  • 15+ Built-in Patterns — rm -rf, kubectl delete, terraform destroy, docker system prune, and more
  • Custom Rules — Add organization-specific dangerous command patterns
  • Team Config — Share rules via .terminal-safety-rules.yaml
  • Explanation Text — Each warning explains why the command is dangerous

Why Terminal Safety Rails?

Fat-finger mistakes in the terminal are unrecoverable. This plugin adds a critical safety layer that costs zero productivity for safe commands and saves potentially catastrophic outcomes for dangerous ones.

Free vs Pro

  • Free: All core features — command interception, risk levels, 15+ patterns, custom rules, team config
  • Pro: Command audit logging, team analytics, Slack/Teams notifications for critical commands, per-environment rules, and command approval workflows
